channel.title: Felipe Coutinho blog
channel.description: I help AI-native teams improve their product the way frontier labs do: benchmarks built from production data, harness tuning and model routing, and open models post-trained for their use case.

item.title: Running a media server on k3s and NixOS
item.description: A project breakdown. Why k3s suits a single NixOS desktop, how to install it with a few lines of Nix, and how to deploy and connect seven media apps.

item.title: Checking the LLM judge before trusting it
item.description: Part 3 of 3. How to test an LLM judge against your own labels before using its scores, and what the tested judge said about each retriever.

item.title: Scoring retrieval without calling a model
item.description: Part 2 of 3. How to score retrievers with gold chunk ids, read the results with confidence intervals, and what a comparison of five retrievers found.

item.title: Building a test set from your own papers
item.description: Part 1 of 3. A step-by-step guide to generating retrieval test questions from your own documents with Ragas, where every question knows which chunks answer it.
